1forsithlord/Product-Master.description: A small PHP + MariaDB web app for managing a product catalogue organized under categories and sub-categories. The front page is a single-page dashboard with filters, pagination, an Add/Edit modal, image upload, and soft-delete.

1forsithlord/yash-water-reminder.description: A lightweight macOS menu-bar app that reminds you to drink water with an upside-down Spider-Man animation dropping from the top-right of the screen.

1forsithlord/rasengan-x-chidori.description: A real-time hand-tracking effects app inspired by two of the most iconic techniques in the Naruto series — the Rasengan and the Chidori
